newsitem.title: CANADA: Northern Orion releases drill results.
newsitem.headline: Northern Orion releases drill results.

text.p: Northern Orion Explorations Ltd said Tuesday that new drilling results from its Agua Rica property in Argentina show the potential for a larger deposit than previously estimated.
Results from five drill holes as part of a 50,000-metre drill program show copper grades ranging from 0.41 percent to 0.70 percent, the company said.

Gold ranged from 0.08 grams of gold per tonne to 0.18 grams per tonne. Silver ranged from 1.9 grams per tonne to 4.7 grams per tonne. Molybdenum was present in grades from 0.014 percent to 0.140 percent.

The results suggest mineralization extends to the north, the company said. Previous estimates suggested the deposit contained 13.5 billion pounds of copper, 9.5 million ounces of gold and 846,000 pounds of molybdenum.

The new drill results have not been factored in but are expected to increase the size of the project, a company spokeswoman said. The results also show the deposit contains a substantial silver resource.
The deposit is a joint venture between Northern Orion percent and BHP Minerals International.
